_comment: Identical to lighthouserc.json except that LCP is advisory (R50). Against a localhost server every asset arrives inside 60 ms, so Lantern's pessimistic LCP graph charges the whole early payload to the paint and reports ~2705 ms on every path alike; the observed LCP is 54 ms, and the same build measures LCP 1503 ms / performance 0.97 under real (--throttling-method=devtools) throttling. gate.sh selects this config for assert only when E2E_BASE_URL is localhost. The binding run is the one against the Vercel preview URL, where LCP is an error — see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md § Quality gate and docs/OPERATING.md.
